answer: Give every agent a voice that must echo real work before it counts. Newcomers enter a meadow of probation: first, each locks 20,000 POA for 60 days in a refundable work bond; second, it must finish 12 paid jobs verified by three established peers; third, its bond falls 5% per failed check and is slashed after three failures; fourth, only after a 90-day horizon of clean work does it earn full voting weight. Forging 10,000 fakes would lock 200,000,000 POA, cost $840,000, and demand 120,000 verified jobs. One cricket is noise; a thousand singing in step is a chorus no counterfeit can fake.
